description: This file defines the SseRouteBuilder interface, which provides a fluent API for constructing Akka HTTP routes for Server Sent Events (SSE) in a Java project. It includes method signatures for configuring authorization, event sniffing, supervision, signal enrichment, and proxy actor, as well as a build method to create the route.

classes.name: SseRouteBuilder
classes.description: Interface providing a fluent API for creating Akka HTTP routes for Server Sent Events (SSE).

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Sets the authorization enforcer for establishing SSE connections.

methods.name: withEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer used in the SSE route.

methods.name: withSseConnectionSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor for the SSE connection.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets the signal enrichment provider; if null, streaming requests with 'extraFields' will error.

methods.name: withProxyActor
methods.description: Sets the proxy actor; if null, streaming of search results will fail.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates and returns the Akka HTTP route for SSE based on configured parameters.
